arguments.prompt: This app integrates an external CLI tool called "rtk". I need to understand: (1) How does the app locate/find the rtk binary on a machine — what's the resolution order (env var, PATH, bundled binary, config, etc.)? (2) What platform-specific behavior exists — specifically what happens on Windows versus other platforms (macOS/Linux) when locating, downloading, or invoking rtk? (3) What timeouts and retry limits bound the rtk download and unpack/extract path (e.g. HTTP request timeout, max retries, unpack timeout)? Provide precise file:line citations for every claim.
